llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must represent collapsed/expanded states with a Reanimated progress shared value (for example `0`/`1`) and map it to card height via `interpolate(...)` in `useAnimatedStyle`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedStyle maps isExpanded to height via a ternary conditional (isExpanded.value === 1 ? 100 : 0) rather than interpolate(...), so height is not interpolated across the 0–1 range during the spring animation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Header press must toggle the progress shared value between collapsed/expanded states using `withSpring(...)` from `react-native-reanimated`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Header press calls toggleCard which sets isExpanded.value = withSpring(...), correctly toggling between 0 and 1 using a spring animation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Card/details visuals must be driven by Reanimated animated styles (`Animated.View` + `useAnimatedStyle`) instead of direct non-animated React style toggles.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: animatedDetailsStyle is applied to a plain View, not an Animated.View. Animated styles from useAnimatedStyle must be applied to Reanimated's Animated.View to be driven by the worklet runtime without layout jumps.
evidence: import { StyleSheet, Text, View, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native' — Animated is never imported from react-native-reanimated
